BillHeading.BriefDescription: Designating apple pie as the official pie of Washington.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating apple pie as the official pie of Washington; and adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Apple pie is designated as the official pie of the state of Washington.
